name: broken_key
description: a brass key that has been ritually broken in half and bound with an occult heat-seal. the two halves, when joined, form a complete key. the tag reads: 'eleanor's hope chest — never to be opened.'

params.success_message: the heat-seal cracks as you examine the joined halves. the key is whole again. it feels powerful — and sad. this key was meant to keep something locked away forever.
